t: Greetings to faculty members, students, post-graduates and graduates of the Russian University of Transport (MIIT)
d: Vladimir Putin sent a congratulatory message to faculty members, students, post-graduates and graduates of the Russian University of Transport (MIIT) on its 130 th anniversary.

t: Telephone conversation with President of Serbia Aleksandar Vucic
d: Vladimir Putin held a telephone conversation with President of Serbia Aleksandar Vucic at the initiative of the Serbian side.
